headlines.text: Flash back to 2025, when after 2 matches, Guevara & Rhodes debuted a bold new identity: The Sons of Texas, on Collision.

Rewind to 2023, when Roderick Strong vs. Chris Jericho settled things in a Falls Count Anywhere match on Dynamite, rated 8.24 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle in a hard-fought men's division clash.
That Friday in 2024, Brian Cage vs. Anthony Bowens locked horns for the first time, in the night's main event on Rampage, rated 5.73.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2025, after 3 matches, Roppongi Vice debuted a bold new identity: RPG Vice, on Collision.
On this day in 2023, Allin & Cassidy kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.98.
It was 2023 when it was a welcome sight as Rush returned to the ring after just under 3 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
